description: This file defines the AesEncryptingStream class, which implements an encrypted data stream using AES encryption, supporting streaming encryption with padding and seek capabilities.

classes.name: AesEncryptingStream
classes.description: A class that provides a streaming encrypted interface over a plaintext data stream, encrypting data on-the-fly using AES encryption and supporting seeking and size queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the encrypting stream with a plaintext stream, encryption key, and cipher method.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL name of the cipher method used for encryption.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the AES name of the cipher method used.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the current initialization vector used by the cipher method.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size of the encrypted data, including padding if required.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream is not writable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and returns encrypted data from the stream, encrypting additional blocks as needed.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the stream, adjusting buffers and cipher state accordingly.

methods.name: encryptBlock
methods.description: Encrypts a block of plaintext data read from the underlying stream, using OpenSSL encryption functions.
